description: This class provides functionality to revise JSON key names by replacing specific characters (like '.' and '$') with their unicode counterparts and vice versa. It is used to handle problematic characters in JSON keys, especially for MongoDB document serialization.

classes.name: KeyNameReviser
classes.description: A utility class implementing Function<String, String> to modify JSON key names by replacing certain characters with unicode equivalents or decoding them back.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new KeyNameReviser with the specified replacement function.

methods.name: escapeProblematicPlainChars
methods.description: Creates a KeyNameReviser that replaces '.' and '$' characters with their unicode counterparts.

methods.name: decodeKnownUnicodeChars
methods.description: Creates a KeyNameReviser that replaces unicode dollar and dot characters with their standard characters.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the replacement function to a given key name, asserting it's not null.
